{{Otheruses|IV}}
The '''IV tap''', also known simply as an '''IV''', was a surgically-inserted medical device used to quickly administer [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] into the bloodstream. It consisted of a long tube with a needle at one end, which would be inserted into the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] vessels, and a time-metered dispensary module for stimulants or medicines.

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Gheeta]], the [[Shell Hutts|Shell Hutt]], used an IV tap to infuse a rage-provoking stimulant into his bloodstream in his attempt to bring down [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and his team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The [[Ssi-ruu]]k used IVs to administer drugs into victims before undergoing [[entechment]].
